source: live account capture via the read API (val-rocky, validation fleet)

alert.title: SSH root login with password enabled
alert.message: PermitRootLogin is "yes" and PasswordAuthentication is "yes". Root can be brute-forced over SSH.
alert.recommendation: Set "PermitRootLogin prohibit-password" in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and restart sshd. Key-based root login still works.
